name: Calendar
hint: Turn on Sample content, then switch to Week: the selected row zooms out of the month and its chips grow into time blocks. Drag empty time to add a session, drag a block to move it.
description: An events calendar with month and week views. You pass `events` (id, title, date, an optional end date, start and end times, a calendar id) and optional `calendars` for colour and a toggleable legend; the selected day (`value`) and the visible month (`month`) work controlled or uncontrolled, with `min`, `max` and `isDateDisabled` for days that cannot be picked, `renderDay` for a mark in each cell, and `locale` and `weekStartsOn` for the names and the first column. Month and Week are one surface: switching zooms the selected week's row out of the month grid, its day cells becoming the time-grid columns, the dates flying into the column heads, chips growing into time blocks and multi-day bars landing in the all-day lane, while the other rows fall away; going back reverses it. Prev/next slides the grid in the direction of travel. Month shows chips, spanning bars with 2px gaps and a '+n more' day popover; Week shows a live now line, overlapping events side by side, and with `onCreate` / `onEventChange` drag-to-create snapping to 15 minutes, drag to move and drag the bottom edge to resize, all on springs. Full grid keyboard model (arrows, Home/End for the week, PageUp/Down for months, Enter, T for today, M/W for views); every day cell is named with its full date and today is marked with a filled pill and aria-current. On a phone it re-composes: a compact month of dots and bars over an agenda for the selected day, a swipeable 3-day time grid and bottom-sheet details. The sample content is the class and booking schedule of a bouldering gym.

month calendar with events per day

calendar with colour coded calendars and legend
usage: Use for a schedule people browse and edit: team events, classes and bookings, room or studio time, deadlines on a month. Pass `events` (dates as ISO "YYYY-MM-DD" strings or Dates, times as "HH:MM"), own the chosen day with `value` + `onChange` and the shown month with `month` + `onMonthChange` (both report ISO strings), and handle `onEventClick` to open your own detail (without it a small detail popover shows). Pass `onCreate` to let people drag out new events and `onEventChange` to let them move and resize; apply both to `events` yourself. Give each calendar a fixed identity colour in a stable order with `calendars`, and keep startHour/endHour to the working hours so the week grid fits without scrolling. For picking a single date in a form, use Date Picker instead.

dataProps.description: [{ id, title, date, endDate?, start?, end?, allDay?, calendar?, tone?, location?, description? }]. date / endDate: ISO "YYYY-MM-DD" or a Date; start / end: "HH:MM", an ISO date-time or a Date (no start makes it all-day; endDate makes an all-day event span days); calendar is a calendars id, tone a series index when there are no calendars.
[{ id, label }] in a stable order: each gets a series colour and a legend toggle that hides its events.
Controlled selected day. Pass with onChange; null for none.
Uncontrolled starting selected day.
(iso, { date }) => void when a day is picked (click, Enter or Space). Arrow keys move focus only. Unavailable days never fire.
Controlled visible month (any day in it). Pass with onMonthChange; in month view the grid only moves when you change it.
Uncontrolled starting month. Default: the month of value, else today.
(isoFirstOfMonth, { date }) => void when prev / next, PageUp / PageDown, Today or an arrow key asks for another month.
First day that can be picked; earlier days are struck through and prev stops there.
Last day that can be picked; next stops there.
(iso, date) => boolean for days that cannot be picked (focusable, announced as unavailable, struck through).

(iso, { date, events, selected, today, disabled, outside }) => node drawn in the top-right of each month cell (under the number on a phone, in place of the dots). Keep it small: a count, a dot, a price.
(event, { date }) => void when an event chip, block or agenda row is chosen. Without it a small read-only detail popover opens.
({ date, start, end, title, calendar }) => void from dragging out time in the week grid or the New event form. Creating is only offered when this is passed; add the event to events yourself.
(event, { date, start, end } | { date, endDate }) => void after a drag-move, a resize or the reschedule steppers. Only offered when this is passed; apply it to events yourself.
("month" | "week") => void when the view switches (the segmented control, M / W, double-click a day).
Controlled ids of calendars switched off in the legend. Pass with onHiddenCalendarsChange.
Uncontrolled ids of calendars that start switched off.
(ids) => void when a legend toggle changes.
The day marked as today (a filled pill and aria-current="date"). Default: the real current date.
BCP 47 locale for month, weekday, date and time names. Default: the locale of the nearest <Theme> ("en-US" when none sets one); the sample keeps its English names unless you set it.
("HH:MM") => string for every time shown. Default: the locale's short time.
